content.user_title: Review Pull Requests with AI Agents
content.value_statement: Manual pull request review can miss bugs, logic errors, and repository rule violations. This skill coordinates multiple AI reviewers and validates findings before reporting concise results.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether a pull request should be reviewed before doing deeper analysis.
Collects relevant AGENTS.md guideline files for compliance review.
Uses GitHub CLI output and PR diffs to summarize changed files.
Runs parallel AI reviewers for guideline compliance, bug detection, and logic analysis.
Validates proposed findings before reporting them to reduce false positives.
Can post inline GitHub comments when the user enables the comment option.
limitations: Requires GitHub CLI authentication and the bundled github-pr skill.
Focuses on pull request diffs, so broad architectural review is limited.
May skip draft, closed, trivial, or already reviewed pull requests.
Does not replace human approval for security-sensitive or high-impact changes.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge bug screening
use_cases.description: Run a focused review before merging a meaningful pull request.

use_cases.title: Repository guideline enforcement
use_cases.description: Check whether changed files follow applicable AGENTS.md rules.

use_cases.title: AI-assisted reviewer support
use_cases.description: Generate high-signal review notes that a human reviewer can verify.

prompt_templates.title: Review the current pull request
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you want terminal output only.

prompt_templates.title: Review and post comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you want validated findings posted to GitHub.

prompt_templates.title: Check guideline compliance before merge
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review and focus on AGENTS.md compliance for this pull request.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when repository rules are important for the change.

prompt_templates.title: Run a high-signal bug review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run /code-review and report only validated runtime bugs or logic issues introduced by this PR.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for larger pull requests where false positives would slow review.

output_examples.input: Review the current branch pull request.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes the PR, checks applicable guidelines, and reports only validated issues with file and line references.
The skill posts one concise inline comment per unique validated issue when the comment option is enabled.
The skill reports that no issues were found after checking for bugs and guideline compliance.

best_practices: Use it on focused pull requests with clear descriptions and meaningful diffs.
Keep AGENTS.md rules specific so compliance findings can cite exact requirements.
Review posted comments before treating them as merge blockers.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as the only review for security-critical changes.
Do not run it on urgent hotfixes when immediate human judgment is required.
Do not treat subjective suggestions as findings unless repository guidelines require them.

faq.question: Does this skill post comments automatically?
faq.answer: No. It posts GitHub comments only when the user runs the command with the comment option.

faq.question: What tools does it require?
faq.answer: It requires GitHub CLI authentication and the bundled github-pr skill scripts.

faq.question: What does it review?
faq.answer: It reviews pull request changes for bugs, logic issues, and applicable AGENTS.md compliance rules.

faq.question: How does it reduce false positives?
faq.answer: It validates each proposed issue with a separate agent and filters low-confidence or pre-existing issues.

faq.question: Can it review draft pull requests?
faq.answer: The workflow is designed to skip draft pull requests during its pre-check.

faq.question: Is it suitable for all pull requests?
faq.answer: It is best for meaningful code changes. Trivial, closed, or urgent hotfix pull requests may be skipped or unsuitable.
